title: The config cue regex /\bconfig(?:uration)?\b/i is broad and will match nearly a…
body: The config cue regex /\bconfig(?:uration)?\b/i is broad and will match nearly any PRD that mentions 'config'/'configuration', which may add a low-signal 'Configuration change' row to the setup checklist for most PRs. Consider narrowing it or ordering it last. Non-blocking.
